en.title: Western Canada weekend: Whistler Blackcomb gains 47 centimetres
en.description: Whistler Blackcomb forecast to gain 47 centimetres by Saturday as snow arrives Thursday through the region, according to our model run on 4 November.
en.lede: If you are choosing where to ski this weekend, Whistler Blackcomb leads by forecast. The mountain will collect 47 centimetres of new snow from Thursday through Saturday, with the heaviest falls on Saturday morning.

p: Rank these resorts by what they will gain over the next three days. Whistler Blackcomb sits at the top with 47 centimetres forecast. Mount Cain Alpine Park follows with 34 centimetres. Big White and Silver Star, both strong on the map today with 91 and 97 centimetres respectively in their upper slopes, will see only 6 and 7 centimetres of new material. This is not uncommon in early November: upper elevations of the drier interior have built reasonable snowpack already, whilst the coastal ranges are ready to load.
The story this weekend is not thickness; it is fresh snow at the right place.

At Whistler Blackcomb, the incoming snow will concentrate above 1,500 metres. Our model estimates that the mid-elevations (around 1,456 metres) will gain 50 centimetres over the next week, whilst the summit will gain 74 centimetres. At the base, 653 metres, there is nothing: rain will fall there for most of the system. This is typical for coastal mountains in autumn.

At Mount Cain Alpine Park, the picture is steeper. The top (1,616 metres) will collect 27 centimetres of the 34 expected, whilst the base (1,190 metres) will get only 5 centimetres. That height difference matters. If you have flexibility, ski high and north-facing to find stable snow that has not been reworked by water.

The snow begins Thursday morning with 11 centimetres at Whistler Blackcomb and 9 centimetres at Mount Cain Alpine Park. Friday is the working day: Whistler takes another 16 centimetres, Mount Cain gets 21 centimetres. Saturday is dramatic. Whistler will see 20 centimetres of new snow, arriving in the morning. Mount Cain will see only 4 centimetres on Saturday as the system moves east.
If you want the freshest runs on Saturday, Whistler has the edge. If Friday is your day, Mount Cain could be less tracked.

Watch the freezing level closely. On Thursday at Whistler Blackcomb it drops to 1,300 metres; snow falls above that line. By Saturday, it rises to 1,980 metres. This means that on Friday at Whistler, rain will fall to roughly 1,360 metres. Any snow below that will soften or crust. The upper slopes stay cold and dry.

At Mount Cain Alpine Park, the freezing level on Wednesday is variable (1,390–2,320 metres) and dips Friday morning, then rises Saturday. Early-season snow is thin everywhere. Rocks poke through at both resorts. Stay on groomed pistes to avoid damage to your skis and to your day.

Before you drive, ring the resort and confirm that lifts are open. The pattern ahead favours the high terrain at both mountains. Big White and Silver Star remain solid choices if you prefer established snow and stable conditions, but neither will refresh significantly this weekend. Whistler and Mount Cain are the play for fresh tracks.

advice: Whistler Blackcomb gains the most new snow on Saturday morning; Mount Cain peaks on Friday: plan your day accordingly.
Both mountains see rain below 1,400 metres on Friday: aim for elevations above 1,500 metres for the best quality snow.
Early-season snow is thin and rocks are common: stay on marked pistes and avoid off-piste terrain unless you have read the official avalanche bulletin and are with a qualified guide.
Check the resort website to confirm lifts are running before you travel.
North-facing slopes and high ridges hold snow longest into spring; they are your safety margin in November.

ar.title: فين تتزلج فغرب كندا هاد الويكاند: Mount Cain Alpine Park, Whistler Blackcomb و Silver Star
ar.description: جمعنا العلو ديال التلج ديال اليوم، والتلج الجديد ديال 72 ساعة، والتوقعات باش نختارو Mount Cain Alpine Park, Whistler Blackcomb و Silver Star. من هاد …
ar.lede: جمعنا العلو ديال التلج ديال اليوم، والتلج الجديد ديال 72 ساعة، والتوقعات باش نختارو Mount Cain Alpine Park, Whistler Blackcomb و Silver Star. من هاد المحطات، Silver Star فيها أكثر تلج فالجهة الفوقانية اليوم، تقريبا 97 سم؛ من بعدها Big White 91 سم و Mount Cain Alpine Park 69 سم.

p: Mount Cain Alpine Park طاح فيها 5 سم ديال تلج جديد ف 72 ساعة اللي فاتو، منهم 3 سم ف 24 ساعة اللي فاتو. العلو مهم: ف Mount Cain Alpine Park، الموديل ديالنا كيعطي 59 سم فالفوق (1616 م)، 23 سم فالوسط (1403 م) و 6 سم فالتحت (1190 م).
العلو مهم: ف Whistler Blackcomb، الموديل ديالنا كيعطي 32 سم فالفوق (2259 م)، 18 سم فالوسط (1456 م) و 0 سم فالتحت (653 م).
الساتليتات شافو Silver Star مغطية بالتلج نهار 2 نونبر، آخر نهار صافي.
ف Mount Cain Alpine Park، علو الجليد غادي يكون بين 1390 م و 2320 م نهار 6 نونبر، فوق أعلى نقطة فالمحطة (1616 م): داك النهار يمكن تكون الشتا ولا تلج مبلول فكاع البيستات.
قلب على التلج فالعلو وفالجهات اللي كتشوف للشمال: كيحافظو عليه كثر، والجهات اللي كتشوف للجنوب كيمشي ليهم بالشمس.
قبل ما تخرج من البيست ولا دير جولة، قرا النشرة الرسمية ديال الانهيارات (الروابط لتحت).
حتى ل 7 نونبر، التوقعات ديالنا كتعطي 34 سم ف Mount Cain Alpine Park، 47 سم ف Whistler Blackcomb و 7 سم ف Silver Star.
التوقعات ديال شي أيام يمكن تتبدل: عاود شوف الخريطة نهار قبل ما تسافر.

advice: التلج فالخريطة ماكيعنيش بلي المحطة محلولة: شوف التيليسييج والتواريخ فالموقع ديال المحطة.
المحطات الصغار اللي قراب من اللولين كيكون فيهم نفس التلج بناس قلال: قارنهم فالخريطة.
التلج ديال بداية الموسم رقيق. بقى فالبيستات المحلولة والمدكوكة: الحجر والربيع يمكن يكونو تحت نيشان.
قلب على التلج فالعلو وفالجهات اللي كتشوف للشمال: كيحافظو عليه كثر، والجهات اللي كتشوف للجنوب كيمشي ليهم بالشمس.
فعّل تنبيه ديال التلج الطري فالتطبيق ديال SnowScope باش تعرف إمتى Mount Cain Alpine Park يجيها تلج جديد.
